FUNCTION CASE007_L1_RENAMED(X)
  CASE007_L1_RENAMED = 0
  IF (X >= 24) THEN
    CASE007_L1_RENAMED = 1
  END IF
  CASE007_L1_RENAMED = CASE007_L1_RENAMED
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE007_L2(X)

  CASE007_L2 = CASE007_L2
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE007_L3(X)
  CASE007_L3 = 0
  IF (CASE007_L2(X) >= 1) THEN
    CASE007_L3 = 1
  END IF
  CASE007_L3 = CASE007_L3
END FUNCTION
